title: Right Quillen recognition on fibrant objects and trivial fibrations
statement: Use model categories, fibrant objects and Quillen adjunctions as defined in [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction]. Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be model categories and $L:\mathcal A\rightleftarrows\mathcal B:R$ an ordinary adjunction, not initially assumed Quillen. Suppose that $R$ sends every trivial fibration in $\mathcal B$ to a trivial fibration in $\mathcal A$, and that $R$ sends every fibration $p:X\to Y$ in $\mathcal B$ with both $X$ and $Y$ fibrant to a fibration in $\mathcal A$. Then $L\dashv R$ is a Quillen adjunction; in particular $R$ preserves all fibrations and $L$ preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. No enrichment, properness or combinatoriality is required.

source.place: Hirschhorn, Model Categories and Their Localizations, Proposition 8.5.4, implication (3) to (1), printed pp. 153-155 (statement on pp. 153-154), attributed there to D. Dugger. Read online; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this model-category result.
